name: Xarus
source: Xarus is your party's tank and most skilled member, but as good as he may be, his brashness keeps him from working alongside others. He doesn't take kindly to weakness, yet you notice some vulnerability as a result of a past betrayal. With a rival that challenges him at every step, he's determined to prove his worth by taking down the virus himself. Can you get this hotheaded warrior to lay down his pride for you and your teammates, or will his trauma get the best of him?
